classes.name: retrieval-document-miss
classes.definition: No chunk of any evidence document reached the returned depth: the passage was never a candidate.
classes.decided_by: the item's gold quote is in no returned chunk and at least one gold evidence doc_id is absent from retrieved[]

classes.name: retrieval-chunk-miss
classes.definition: The evidence document was retrieved, but no returned chunk contains the evidence quote -- the passage was split into a sibling chunk or into a parent that was not expanded.
classes.decided_by: the gold quote is in no returned chunk while every gold evidence doc_id is in retrieved[]

classes.name: context-budget-drop
classes.definition: Every retrieved chunk carrying the quote sits beyond llm.context_chunks, so the passage never entered the prompt.
classes.decided_by: the quote-bearing chunk's rank exceeds the run's config.json llm.context_chunks

classes.name: generator-over-abstention
classes.definition: The generator refused an answerable question with the whole evidence set inside its context window.
classes.decided_by: abstained on an answerable item whose every gold quote sits at a rank within llm.context_chunks

classes.name: generator-under-abstention
classes.definition: The generator answered a question the knowledge base does not answer, from neighbouring documentation.
classes.decided_by: not abstained on an item whose golden answerable flag is false

classes.name: citation-quote-not-in-chunk
classes.definition: The claim's quoted span does not occur in the chunk it is cited against: a fabricated, spliced or mangled span.
classes.decided_by: citations.jsonl error_class = quote_not_in_chunk, re-checked by locating the quote in the rebuilt chunk text

classes.name: citation-span-out-of-bounds
classes.definition: The quoted text does occur, but the reported offsets do not delimit it.

classes.name: citation-chunk-not-retrieved
classes.definition: The claim cites a chunk id that was never in the retrieved set.

classes.name: generation-parse-failure
classes.definition: The response could not be parsed into claims, so the item produced no verdict at all.
classes.decided_by: errors.jsonl class = parse_failure, with tokens_out and the raw response inspected

sampling.rule: stratified by class with a fixed quota per class, then round-robin over cells in run-id order, one event per cell per pass, preferring an item the sample has not used yet; quotas are set for coverage, not for rate estimation

sample.justification: `docs/commands/operator/init`, the page that says 'requires an _unseal key_ to decrypt it', is in none of the ten chunks; the returned set is `system/rotate`, `pki/quick-start-root-ca` and `generate-root`, and `docs/concepts/seal` appears only at rank 9, outside the eight-chunk window.

`docs/concepts/seal` is absent; the ranker read 'what state does a server start in' as a dev-server question (`dev-server`, `run-as-service`, `ui`) and the generator answered from that page -- 'starts automatically initialized and unsealed' -- the opposite of the reference's sealed state.

same item and same missing page as row 1; here the generator abstained instead of answering from memory, which is the abstention the miss causes -- the cause is the absent `docs/commands/operator/init`, not the abstention policy.

`docs/concepts/seal` is returned four times and carries the recovery-key half, but the second evidence page `docs/configuration/seal/seal-best-practices` is absent, and the answer says 'generating a root token' where the reference says 'generating new root keys' -- the distinction only the missing page draws.

`docs/internals/recommended-patterns` is absent and the top ten are lease telemetry partials plus `lease/renew` and `lease/lookup`, none of which states a default TTL; the 32 days in the answer has no supporting chunk.

`docs/concepts/seal` at ranks 1 and 8, `seal-best-practices` absent; the answer again substitutes 'generating a root token' for 'generating new root keys', so one page gap reappears as the same answer error under a different ranker.

reranking lifts `docs/concepts/seal` to ranks 1 and 2 and still never returns `seal-best-practices`: the missing page survives a change of ranker, which points at coverage of the question rather than at ordering.
`docs/internals/recommended-patterns` absent again; the answer keeps 32 days and drops the '768 hours' form the reference pairs with it, and no returned chunk states either value.
`docs/concepts/seal` at ranks 1 and 4, `seal-best-practices` absent, answer again 'generating a root token': third cell family, same page, same substitution.

`docs/configuration` is absent and all ten chunks are lease API or concept pages, so an option named `remove_irrevocable_lease_after` never appears; the abstention is correct behaviour for this context and the wrong answer for the corpus.

same returned set as row 2 (`dev-server`, `run-as-service`, `ui`) with `docs/concepts/seal` absent: parent-child chunking changed the chunk shape and not the candidate set, so the answer describes dev mode again.

`docs/commands/operator/init` absent; this cell answered 'the HSM is needed to decrypt it' from `docs/enterprise/hsm` at rank 7 -- a different mechanism, and the citation trail holds no chunk with the gold sentence.
`docs/concepts/seal` at rank 1 only, `seal-best-practices` absent; the answer's second half is built from the seal page alone and again names a root token rather than new root keys.

`docs/concepts/tune-server-performance` is absent -- the ten chunks are agent and proxy caching pages -- yet the answer gives 131,072: the number is right and the evidence trail is empty, which is the failure this class exists to catch.

`docs/concepts/seal` at rank 1, `seal-best-practices` absent; A028 fails this way in nearly every cell it appears in, so this is one page-coverage gap reproduced across the matrix, not independent generator errors.
`docs/concepts/seal` at rank 1 and no `seal-best-practices`; 'operations besides unsealing that require a quorum' is assembled from the seal page, without the page that names the privileged actions.
`tune-server-performance` absent, ten agent and proxy caching chunks returned, and the answer states 131072 with nothing retrieved to support it.
`docs/concepts/seal` at rank 1, `seal-best-practices` absent; eighth instance of this page gap in the sample, with the same 'root token' substitution in the answer.

`docs/enterprise/replication` is returned at ranks 5 and 6 and neither chunk contains 'applications must reauthenticate and obtain new leases from the newly-promoted primary'; the generator abstained saying the context only covers switching clusters, so the page arrived and the paragraph did not.

`docs/concepts/tokens` is returned only at rank 10 and that chunk does not carry 'Tokens have a specific prefix that indicates their type'; ranks 1-9 are token telemetry partials, so the abstention tracks a chunk boundary, not a judgement call.

replication at ranks 1 and 6, neither with the promoted-secondary sentence; the generator answered from the neighbouring 're-authenticate if they switch clusters' text -- right conclusion, no returned chunk supports it.

both evidence pages are returned (`tune-server-performance`, `internals/limits`) and neither chunk carries its quote, so the answer could not have been grounded; the body is also empty because the call spent its whole budget (tokens_out 3200 against max_tokens 1600), the parse failure recorded beside this item.

`docs/concepts/policies` at rank 2 supplies the 'root policy cannot be modified' half, but `docs/concepts/tokens` at rank 4 does not carry 'Root tokens are tokens that have the `root` policy attached'; the answer is nonetheless correct, a chunk-placement miss with no visible answer error.

`tune-server-performance` at rank 7 without the 131072 row, and this time the generator answered the opposite -- 'unlimited in size... no fixed default entry count' -- the wrong-answer form of the same chunk boundary.

the quote-bearing `docs/auth/login-mfa` chunk is at rank 10 and the window holds 8, so 'Vault allows for 5 consecutive failed TOTP passcode validations' never entered the prompt; the abstention is the window's doing, not the generator's.
`docs/concepts/mount-migration` is at rank 9, outside the eight-chunk window; the answer is right anyway ('the status can be in-progress'), so a real window drop is hidden behind a lucky answer.
the lease-count row of `docs/concepts/resource-quotas` sits at rank 9; the answer is correct ('lease count quota... enterprise-only'), again hiding the drop.

the prefix sentence is at rank 9, so the prompt held the service-versus-batch differences but not 'tokens have a specific prefix'; the generator abstained and listed the differences it could see, which is what a window drop looks like from outside.

the audit-page quote is at rank 1 and 'Vault will not respond to requests when audit devices are not enabled' is at rank 10, outside the window; the answer still contains both halves, so the second half did not come from the retrieved context.

the 300-character quote is verbatim for 74 characters and then diverges where the chunk writes a markdown link (`[TLS](...)`) that the model flattened to plain 'TLS': the prose is faithful and the exact-string containment check is not.
verbatim for 54 characters, then the model inserts '(e.g., 1.16, 1.19)' which the page does not contain, and resumes verbatim afterwards: an inserted example inside an otherwise real span.

the opening 40 characters of the Shamir quote occur nowhere in the cited `docs/commands/operator/init` chunk, and the full quote occurs in no rebuilt chunk: a summary of the page returned as a quotation.

the cited `docs/concepts/client-count` chunk defines what a client is; the 'entity aliases...' sentence is in `docs/concepts/identity`, retrieved at rank 1, so the passage was in the prompt and the citation names the wrong page.

the quoted sentence exists verbatim in `docs/concepts/mount-migration` chunk `c-3e3cd28f822244e7`, retrieved at rank 1, and is cited against `api-docs/system/remount`, where it does not occur: real evidence, wrong citation target.

verbatim for 155 of 183 characters and then diverges at the chunk's markdown link `[generate-root](...)`, which the model wrote as plain `generate-root`; the sentence is faithful and the containment check is formatting-sensitive.

the model cited `c-87c83bb5d923ceb`; the real chunk is `c-87c83bb5d923cece`, one hex character longer, and it was retrieved at rank 2 -- the id was mistyped, so an otherwise correct citation was rejected as pointing outside the context.
same mistyped id in the plain cell (`c-87c83bb5d923ceb` against `c-87c83bb5d923cece` at rank 2): the defect is chunk-id fidelity in the generator's output, not retrieval.

`tokens_out` is 3200 against `max_tokens` 1600 and the response body is empty: the call consumed its whole output budget and emitted no envelope, with both evidence quotes in the window at ranks 2 and 1.

the envelope is cut mid-quote after 382 characters with `tokens_out` 3200 = 2 x `max_tokens`; the item also lost its second evidence passage to the window (rank 10 of 8), so two defects stack and the empty body is counted here.

the provider returned an empty string with `tokens_out` at the 3200 cap and no error detail: budget exhaustion with nothing written, a different mechanism from a truncated envelope and the same class.
